profile.name: Luminos 偏航旋转轴
profile.description: Luminos 系列中的电动偏航旋转轴，用于带动光学元件、探针或样品进行高精度偏航角调整。该类轴常用于光学耦合、光束对准、样品姿态校准和多轴精密定位实验。
profile.description_en: A motorized yaw rotation axis in the Luminos series, used to precisely adjust the yaw angle of optical components, probes, or samples. This type of axis is commonly used for optical coupling, beam alignment, sample orientation, and multi-axis precision positioning in laboratory setups.
